messages:
Nora: Idea: 'Global Summer in Winter' postcard party  send a sunny postcard from wherever you are. We'll set up a table at HQ with sticker packs, tiny thank-you notes, and a plant raffle. Sign-up (opt-out for international): http://tiny.redwood/summer-in-winter
Ben: 100% in. Can we add a "no-return-address" opt? I'm paranoid. :grimacing:
Li: Love this. I'll make 3 postcard templates (beach, city skyline, funny meme). React with :one: :two: :three: for preference.
Mateo: I can handle Bay Area drop-offs and local postage runs. Also willing to be a sticker wrangler. :package:
Izzy: For privacy, let's collect addresses in the sheet only. Columns: `slack`, `name for label`, `city/region`, `can_receive_mail (Y/N)`, `style pref (1/2/3)`. Share the PDF when ready.
Nora: We'll have a tiny prompt on the back: "One-line summer memory from my spot:" keep it short. Also doing a mini kudos stack  write a 1-line thank-you to drop in an envelope if you like.
PostBot: Reminder scheduled: "Summer-in-Winter postcard box opens" Wed 09:00. :bell:
Ben: Poll: sticker pack design? React with :sun_with_face: for retro summer, :palm_tree: for minimal, :smile_cat: for silly cats in sunglasses.
Li: Uploaded templates, PDF link: http://tiny.redwood/summer-templates (placeholder). Will print 50 copies by Thursday.
Mateo: Also suggest labeling envelopes like `SIW-<slack>` so mail ops can route.
Izzy: Heads up: international senders please check customs rules for postcards. MailOps can't help with customs forms.
Nora: Sign-ups close Tue EOD so we can print and pack stickers. Thanks all! :raised_hands: Looking forward to sunny mail.
